catalog_access: Search index preserves record; current direct URL redirects to NASA Earth Observatory homepage. Original NASA image endpoint remains accessible.
credit: NASA Goddard Space Flight Center / Reto Stöckli (clouds); Robert Simmon (compositing)
data_semantics: MODIS visible cloud mosaic from two days plus thermal infrared third-day polar coverage; published 2002-02-11. Frozen visual layer, not current weather or same-date data as 2004-01 land map.
postprocess: Original JPEG unchanged; shader maps greyscale to display opacity, not retrieved optical depth.
